A taste of home in hanoi!
Aug 2026 • Family
Ram Krishna Hotel, Hanoi — ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

We had such a lovely experience at Ram Krishna Hotel in Hanoi! The staff were incredibly friendly, warm, and helpful, and the restaurant had a great selection of both vegetarian and vegan options.

We ordered the hara bhara kebab, dal tadka, veg crispy, garlic naan, tandoori roti, papad, masala papad, aloo adraki, and baingan bharta — and everything was delicious. It was especially nice to have so many vegetarian options to choose from.

The restaurant is located in a really lovely, local part of the city, which made the experience feel even more authentic and enjoyable. We didn't have to wait long for a table or for our food.

The restaurant was clean and hygienic, had free Wi-Fi, and was kid-friendly as well. There isn't really parking available at the restaurant, but that wasn't a major issue for us.

Overall, a really lovely dining experience. The food, hospitality, cleanliness, and location all made it a place we'd happily visit again while in Hanoi!
